name: SASR Eval pilot: Horn of Africa Somali ASR reference-free pass
description: Exploratory characterization of 4 production ASR systems on Djiboutian Somali audio sampled from 2 publicly broadcast YouTube videos. Reference-free metrics only, ground-truth transcripts have not yet been collected, so no WER/CER.
ground_truth_status: absent, references pending native-speaker correction of ElevenLabs draft transcripts.

sampling.note: BBC clip01 is 107s (user-selected pilot); all other clips are 60s random samples.

salaf_lecture.video_title: Salafmedia, Miisaanka lagu garto Ninka Ragga ah

classification_rules.cross-lingual misroute: arabic char share >= 0.50 (output is in wrong language family)
classification_rules.trailing loop: trailing 12-token n-gram repeat >= 3 OR max consecutive token repeats >= 4
classification_rules.surface-usable: passes all of the above, HEURISTIC ONLY, not validated against ground truth
classification_rules.not_run: no transcript exists for this (clip, vendor) pair

limitations: No ground truth, surface-usable classifications are heuristic. Wait for native-speaker references for any accuracy claim.
N=11 clips drawn from 2 videos = 2 speakers x timestamps, not 11 independent samples.
Single run per (clip, vendor), failure modes are point estimates; determinism unverified.
Deepgram ran on 3 clips only; remaining 8 were skipped after batch hung. All 3 completed runs returned empty.
Vendor language-hint codes differ (som vs so vs multi) because not all vendors accept the same code.
